title: On n-ADC integral quadratic lattices over algebraic number fields
author: Zilong He
citation: Zilong He, On n-ADC integral quadratic lattices over algebraic number fields, Doc. Math. 30 (2025), no. 4, 981-1022

authoritativeSource.repositoryPolicy: not bundled; reviewers obtain and hash-check independently

comparisonSources.description: 38-page arXiv v3 comparison copy, revised 25 December 2025 after publication

formalizedScope: Implication from n-universality to n-ADC and the dyadic stable-rank equivalence in Theorem 1.4(i)
Global predicates and Theorems 1.3-1.4 as logical reductions with explicit undischarged arithmetic premises
Direct endpoints for all six numbered Section 3 items using proved Beli and He-Hu results
Dyadic space classification, codimension-one and codimension-two representation, and ADC lifting endpoints in Section 4
Dyadic maximal table and literal minimal universality testing sets in ranks at least two

The coordinate formula in Remark 4.10, ten concrete-model profile criteria, and thirteen published W/N branches for Lemmas 4.11-4.12 including rank one, with auxiliary defect and unit conditions proved
All three clauses of Proposition 4.13 for arbitrary odd-rank maximal lattices, including rank three and the capped-defect equalities
Dyadic maximal-implies-ADC and equal-rank equivalence in Lemma 4.14 and Proposition 4.15
excludedScope: Concrete number-field localization and proofs of the arithmetic premises used by the global reductions
Non-dyadic local results, Section 6-7 ADC classification, and Section 8 global and enumerative proofs
Remaining Section 4 clauses including Proposition 4.16 and unary minimality
Completion of theorem-by-theorem semantic review and independent human sign-off
reviewNotice: This is an in-progress paper kit. Concrete proofs currently cover the dyadic foundations and selected Section 4 results. Global reductions still require explicit arithmetic premises; the local ADC classifications and enumeration are not complete. See the correspondence report for exact endpoint scope.
